items.prompt: An alchemist's glass flask on an old wooden bench in a dark cellar: inside, a black mass at the bottom, a pale white mist above it and a faint glowing red drop at the top, three layers in one vessel. A candle stub beside it.

alt.ru: Алхимическая колба на старом столе в тёмном подвале: внизу чёрная масса, выше белёсая дымка, наверху слабо светящаяся красная капля.
alt.en: An alchemist's flask on an old bench in a dark cellar: a black mass at the bottom, a pale mist above, a faint glowing red drop at the top.
alt.pt: Um frasco de alquimista numa velha bancada de uma cave escura: massa negra no fundo, névoa pálida por cima, uma gota vermelha luminosa no topo.
alt.es: Un matraz de alquimista sobre un viejo banco en un sótano oscuro: una masa negra en el fondo, una neblina pálida encima, una gota roja luminosa arriba.
